Bank of India Specialist Officer SO Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Bank of India (BOI) has released the notification for the post of Specialist Officer (SO). This recruitment has been issued for 205 posts. The online application process for Bank of India Specialist Officer SO Recruitment 2026 has started on 10 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 25 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Bank of India Specialist Officer SO Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 31 August 2026
  • Application Start Date : 10 September 2026
  • Last Date : 25 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1180/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : Rs. 175/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
